## Sprint 1 result-schema reconciliation

- Used the existing local `live` `immediate` baseline slice on Windows loopback to exercise two baseline controllers through the new controller-selection path.
- Re-ran `cargo run -p harness -- run-suite --config configs/harness/local_live_immediate_baselines.json` and observed the same Windows behavior: the `cubic` transfer completed and wrote its raw report, but `run-suite` did not advance to the `bbr` run or emit suite completion.
- Re-ran `cargo run -p harness -- run-suite --config configs/harness/local_live_immediate_bbr_only.json` and observed the same pattern for the single-run `bbr` suite: transfer summary returned, raw report written, no harness-complete log line afterward.
- Regenerated processed outputs with `cargo run -p harness -- analyze-suite --config configs/harness/local_live_immediate_baselines.json` so processed artifacts matched the fresh raw reports.
- Tightened the result-schema note so it matches the current raw and processed artifact fields, including baseline-run `runtime_utility` nullability and raw summary runtime-utility counters.
- Generated fresh artifacts:
	- `results/raw/harness/live_immediate_cubic_report.json`
	- `results/raw/harness/live_immediate_bbr_report.json`
	- `results/processed/harness/live_immediate_cubic_amc.json`
	- `results/processed/harness/live_immediate_bbr_amc.json`
	- `results/processed/harness/local_live_immediate_baselines_summary.json`
- Reconciled controller identity across raw and processed outputs: raw `summary.baseline_controller`, processed per-run `controller`, and suite-summary `runs[*].controller` agree for both local baseline runs after the offline re-analysis step.

## AMC preview runtime-proof package

- Added a single-run Windows-safe harness config at `configs/harness/local_live_immediate_amc_preview.json` for `controller: amc_preview` on the local loopback scenario.
- First `run-suite` attempt failed during QUIC handshake with `invalid peer certificate: BadSignature` after a 250 ms startup delay, before any raw artifact was written.
- Increased the single-run config startup delay to 1500 ms and retried. With that config-only change, the local harness completed the transfer and wrote `results/raw/harness/live_immediate_amc_preview_report.json`.
- Observed concrete AMC runtime telemetry in the raw proof artifact, not only in code: raw `summary` now includes `amc_runtime_samples: 43`, `max_runtime_utility_score: 0.1755737468051559`, and `min_runtime_utility_score: 0.006104520976293306`.
- Confirmed raw per-observation telemetry is populated for the AMC preview path: `observations[*].runtime_utility` carries `traffic_class`, `importance`, `dependency_depth`, `dependency_ready`, `queue_delay_ms`, `estimated_rtt_ms`, `utility_score`, `ack_gain`, and `loss_reduction_factor`.
- The local `run-suite` path still appeared to hang after the client logged the transfer summary, so it did not emit processed outputs on its own during this proof run.
- Ran `analyze-suite` against the same config and generated `results/processed/harness/live_immediate_amc_preview_amc.json` plus `results/processed/harness/local_live_immediate_amc_preview_summary.json`.
- Reconciled the processed proof artifacts: the suite summary records `controller: amc_preview`, preserves raw `summary.amc_runtime_samples: 43`, and carries the same runtime utility min/max fields alongside the per-run processed `amc_aggregate` utility metrics.

## Local lifecycle and lateness follow-up

- Reworked the Windows-local harness startup path so it deletes any stale certificate, waits for a newly written and parseable certificate, and uses certificate readiness instead of a blind fixed sleep before starting the client.
- Moved demo-server certificate publication to after the QUIC endpoint bind succeeds, so certificate presence now means the server is actually ready to accept the local client.
- Fixed the local shutdown deadlock by having the client explicitly close the QUIC connection after it has received the full transfer summary, allowing both client and server `wait_idle()` paths to complete.
- Corrected `summary.max_observed_lateness_ms` so it reports actual lateness only: the value is now clamped to `0` when all media arrived before deadline instead of surfacing a negative earliness number as the maximum lateness.
- Validation after the fix succeeded for `cargo check -p demo-client`, `cargo check -p demo-server`, `cargo check -p harness`, `cargo run -p harness -- run-suite --config configs/harness/local_live_immediate_bbr_only.json`, `cargo run -p harness -- run-suite --config configs/harness/local_live_immediate_baselines.json`, and `cargo run -p harness -- run-suite --config configs/harness/local_live_immediate_amc_preview.json`.
